Job Description

Why GM Financial? 

GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses.

Our Purpose: We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters.

Are you excited about innovation, entrepreneurship and solving complex business problems? Then we are looking for you!

This position will be posted until filled

Responsibilities

About this role:

This role provides hands-on experience in Agile software development, DevOps practices, and production support while contributing to the delivery of high-quality product features. The position collaborates with cross-functional teams, helps improve development tools and processes, and supports system reliability through vulnerability remediation and a production-first mindset.

In This Role You Will



- Attend and participate in scrum events (the sprint, daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint review, sprint retrospective) 
- Participate in team or departmental meetings 
- Assist with vulnerabilities remediation 
- Assist with building/improvement of DevOps tooling (e.g., pipelines, static scanning etc.) 
- Complete the internship program final capstone presentation 
- Maintain a production-first mindset focused on scale, uptime and ability to rapidly triage/resolve production issues 
- Invest in our Agile practice to continuously improve product quality, time to market
- Learn to develop product features for any of the following: data marketplaces, mobile applications, web applications, and API services 

Qualifications

What makes You an ideal candidate?



- Must be a student pursuing a bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited college or university in Computer Science with at least one semester remaining upon start of the internship. 
- Must possess a minimum of a 3.0 (out of a 4-point scale) GPA.
- Junior or Senior classification preferred. 
- Strong written and verbal communication skills required. This incumbent will be required to give presentations and communicate with business leaders. 
- Strong analytical, quantitative, problem solving, and conceptual skills required. 
- Must be detail oriented and able to prioritize tasks to meet deadlines. 
- Must be able to work independently or in a team setting. 
- Previous internships are considered a plus. 

Additional Knowledge And Skills

Working effectively within an AI enabled environment:



- Ability to use AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to support daily work.
- Skills in evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, compliance, and bias.
- Experience integrating AI into workflows to improve efficiency or insights.
- Familiarity with AI assisted research, summarization, and content generation.
- Understanding of responsible AI use, including ethics and data protection.

AI Skills Preferred  



-  Experience with AI-assisted software development or automation. 
-  Knowledge of prompting techniques to improve output quality. 
-  Awareness of emerging GenAI capabilities and limitations. 

Our program offers 



- 11 weeks of work experience (May 26-August 6, 2027)
- Executive and peer networking opportunities 
- Independent and team project experiences 
- Philanthropic activities 
- Career development 
- Opportunity to apply for full-time career positions 

Our Culture: Our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Compensation: Competitive pay

Work Life Balance: Flexible hybrid work environment, 2-days a week in office

Dayforce, a global leader in Human Capital Management (HCM) with headquarters in Toronto, Ontario, and Minneapolis, Minnesota, operates across North America, EMEA, and APJ regions. Our Cloud HCM platform, recognized for its unified database and continuous calculation engine, enhances efficiency, productivity, and compliance for global workforces. We are committed to "Making Work Life Better™" for employees, customers, and partners worldwide.

As an Intern at Dayforce, you’ll gain real-world experience with meaningful responsibilities, access to development programs, and the chance to collaborate globally, bringing new ideas and optimizing processes across multiple business units.

Job Title: Software Developer Intern

Location: Virtual

Duration: Winter 2027 - 8 Months (January 2027 - August 2027)

Availability: *Full-time availability of 37.5 - 40 hours weekly is required to be eligible for this opportunity.

Benefits For Students



- Experience working for one of the fastest growing Human Capital Management technology companies in the world and access to Dayforce’s development programs and resources
- Ability to work with and build relationships with team members across the globe
- Autonomy to bring forth new ideas and optimize existing structures within the organization
- Meaningful responsibilities, enabling you to obtain real-world experience
- Dynamic hands-on exposure to multiple business units and stakeholders across Dayforce
- Opportunities to work across different technology stacks using modern tools, frameworks, and libraries

About The Opportunity

As a Software Developer Intern at Dayforce, you will join one of our software development teams and contribute to the development of enterprise-scale cloud software used by customers around the world.

Working alongside experienced Software Developers, Test Engineers, Product Managers, UX Designers, and other partners, you will gain hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, code review, troubleshooting, and delivery. Depending on your team placement, you may contribute to areas such as frontend and backend development, APIs and services, test automation, cloud and data platforms, developer tooling, or AI-enabled solutions.

You will receive mentorship and support from experienced team members while being encouraged to ask questions, contribute ideas, learn new technologies, and progressively take ownership of your work. This is an opportunity to strengthen your technical skills while solving real product and customer problems in a collaborative, agile environment.

What You’ll Get To Do



- Design, develop, test, and maintain software features and solutions with support from experienced engineers.
- Write clean, readable, maintainable, and well-tested code using modern software development practices.
- Work cross-functionally with Software Developers, Test Engineers, Product Managers, UX Designers, and other partners to deliver high-quality product experiences.
- Contribute to new product capabilities as well as enhancements and maintenance of existing functionality.
- Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, and delivery.
- Investigate software defects and technical issues, contribute to root-cause analysis, and help drive issues to resolution.
- Develop and maintain automated tests, including unit, integration, and other forms of test automation.
- Work with technologies such as APIs, databases, cloud services, web applications, and development tools based on your team assignment.
- Participate in technical, design, and architectural discussions and learn how engineering teams evaluate technical choices and tradeoffs.
- Contribute to code quality, engineering practices, tooling, automation, and development process improvements.
- Help ensure software can be reliably built, tested, and delivered through modern development and deployment pipelines.
- Explore emerging technologies, including AI-powered development tools, and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solve technical problems.
- Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and approaches while taking increasing ownership of development tasks.

Skills And Experience We Value



- Currently pursuing a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Programming experience gained through coursework, personal projects, internships, hackathons, open-source contributions, or other hands-on experience.
- Familiarity with one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Understanding of programming fundamentals, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving concepts.
- Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.
- Familiarity with software development fundamentals such as debugging, testing, and version control.
- Interest in learning modern software development technologies and practices, including web applications, APIs, cloud technologies, data platforms, automation, or AI.
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with curiosity and a willingness to learn.
- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within an agile development team.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
- A strong sense of ownership and enthusiasm for building high-quality software.

What Would Really Make You Stand Out

Experience with any of the following is an asset, but is not required:



- C#/.NET, Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
- Modern frontend technologies and frameworks such as React, HTML, and CSS.
- REST APIs, JSON, backend services, or microservices.
- Relational or NoSQL databases and data processing technologies.
- Cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
- Automated testing, unit-testing frameworks, or test automation tools.
- Git and collaborative source control practices.
- CI/CD concepts and DevOps tools and practices.
- Docker, Kubernetes, containers, or distributed systems concepts.
- Data and analytics technologies such as Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake platforms.
- AI-powered development tools, AI applications, LLM APIs, agents, or related automation.
- Applying software design patterns and writing maintainable, testable code.
- SaaS or enterprise software development through previous internships, academic projects, personal projects, hackathons, or open-source contributions.

What You’ll Gain



- Hands-on experience contributing to production software in a global SaaS organization.
- Mentorship from experienced software engineers and technical leaders.
- Exposure to modern engineering practices, architecture, cloud technologies, testing, data platforms, AI, and DevOps depending on your team placement.
- Experience collaborating across Engineering, Product, UX, Quality, Data, and other partner teams.
- Opportunities to take increasing ownership as your skills and confidence grow.
- Practical experience solving real customer, product, and engineering problems.

We understand that no matter where you are, choosing a new employer is always one of life’s most stressful events. We encourage you to check us out at Dayforce.com or follow us on LinkedIn to learn more about how we are impacting the world of work for our customers, employees and you!

Fraudulent Recruiting

Beware of fraudulent recruiting. Legitimate Dayforce contacts will use an @dayforce.com or @Ceridian.com email address. We do not request money, checks, equipment orders, or sensitive personal data during the recruitment process. If you have been asked for any of the above, or believe you have been contacted by someone posing as a Dayforce employee, please refer to our fraudulent recruiting statement found here: https://www.dayforce.com/be-aware-of-recruiting-fraud
fit_why: Full-stack SWE intern; React, Node, SQL, Python, Docker, CI all match

7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.

We Began As An Original. We Remain An Original At The Top Of The Convenience Industry. Our company invented the concept of convenience retailing. But we didn’t stop there. 7-Eleven® has captured the world with a proven willingness and ability to innovate. We were the first company in America to offer fresh-brewed to-go coffee. More than six million of our Slurpee® beverages have been sipped since 1966. And, to continuously stay ahead of the curve, we introduce more than 2,500+ new products each year.

With over 77,000 global locations, 7-Eleven Inc. is the world’s largest operator, franchiser and licensor of convenience stores and is also one of the nation’s largest independent gasoline retailers. The company continues to achieve operational accolades, win awards in franchising and drive innovation in retail in the mission to make life a little easier for our guests by being where they need us, when they need us.

Launch your career with real-world impact. Our Internship Program gives you the opportunity to build deep experience in a specific functional area while contributing to a meaningful business project. Build your professional network, learn directly from senior leaders, and gain a behind-the-scenes view of how the business works - bringing our strategy to life. With guidance from a dedicated coach and opportunities to connect across the organization, you will build valuable relationships, broaden your business perspective, and finish the summer by showcasing your work to functional leaders.

The Experience

The paid internship takes place during Summer 2027. You will gain practical experience, grow your professional network, develop in-demand skills, and help shape the future of merchandising at the world’s largest convenience retailer.

About This Opportunity

As an AI Engineer Intern, you will join a multidisciplinary team of senior engineers, API engineers, and AI engineers building customer-facing AI products (conversational shopping and customer support agents) and the AI platform behind them: an AI gateway with model routing, an agent builder framework, MCP services, and observability and evaluation tooling.

This is a hands-on internship. You will own a scoped project from prototype to a demo-ready deliverable, working inside real code, real pipelines, and real engineering standards, with a dedicated mentor and regular code reviews. Interns typically spend about 70% of their time building and 30% learning, pairing, and presenting.

What You Will Do



- Build and test LLM-powered features such as tool and function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-step agent workflows in Python and/or Node.js.
- Develop evaluation harnesses for LLM applications, including golden datasets, regression tests, automated scoring, and trace review.
- Help instrument AI services for observability: tracing, prompt and version tracking, tool-call monitoring, latency, token usage, and cost.
- Experiment with prompts, context design, and retrieval quality; compare models on accuracy, latency, and cost, and document the trade-offs.
- Contribute to the AI platform by building small services, API integrations, SDK samples, or developer tooling that helps other teams adopt the AI gateway and agent framework.
- Write clean, tested, documented code, and participate in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, and design discussions.
- Apply responsible-AI practices, including guardrails, PII handling, and safety testing, in every project.
- Present your project results and recommendations to the team and leadership at the end of the internship.

Required Qualifications



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related field, with an expected graduation date at least one semester and no more than one year after the internship.
- Proficiency in Python; working knowledge of at least one other language such as JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js) or Java.
- Understanding of software fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, REST APIs, and Git workflows.
- Familiarity with LLM concepts such as prompting, embeddings, RAG, and tool calling, gained through coursework, personal projects, or hackathons.
- Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a willingness to learn quickly in a fast-moving field.
- Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable asking questions and giving and receiving feedback.

Preferred Qualifications



- Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, or with model APIs from OpenAI, Google (Gemini/Vertex AI), Anthropic, or Amazon Bedrock.
- Experience with vector databases or search (for example, pgvector, OpenSearch, MongoDB Atlas), and basic SQL or NoSQL databases.
- Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), containers (Docker), and CI/CD.
- Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tools (for example, Langfuse, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry).
- Interest in AI safety, guardrails, and responsible-AI practices.
- Personal projects, open-source contributions, research, or prior internships involving AI/ML or agentic systems (link your GitHub or portfolio).

Welcome to Gordon Food Service! We are excited that you are thinking about opportunities with us, and we have an amazing story to share. See below for a quick glance of who we are and the impact you could have on the food service industry. There's a seat at our table for you... 

 Looking to build connections, careers, and a future at one of North America's largest food service distributors?  Do this and more as a Gordon Food Service intern at our Home Office! 

 Our 12-week paid internship program offers firsthand experience and meaningful projects that have an impact on our business. Throughout the program, you’ll have the opportunity to work alongside industry professionals receiving mentorship, professional development, and networking opportunities that will expose you to various aspects of our industry.  

 Build Connections By:    
 Working alongside our Transportation Routing team that serves our customers, employees, and partners across North America and Canada.  Collaborating with other Gordon Food Service interns and employees in the following areas:  

• Communications   
• Finance 
• Accounting 
• Human Resources  
• IT  
• Marketing & Merchandising  
• Supply Chain  
• Sales 
 Build a Career:  
 In the Transportation Routing department by: 
 
• Using scripting and approved AI tools to organize technical documentation, business rules, integration details, and support procedures into a consistent knowledge structure. Add source links, application tags, document owners, and review dates to prepare content for LLM-based assistants. 
• Building and demonstrating a limited LLM-powered knowledge assistant using approved tools and reviewed documentation. Enable source-linked answers to common routing, onboarding, and support questions, with human review and clear handling of missing or conflicting information. 
• Evaluating the prototype against a small set of real transportation questions and document answer accuracy, source quality, and time to locate information. Deliver the cleaned knowledge set, reusable preparation scripts, maintenance guidance, and recommendations for the broader agentic ecosystem. 
 
 Build the Future by:  
 Being an intern at Gordon Food Service, North America's largest family-owned broadline food service distributor and working alongside our Transportation Routing department. 

• Attending unique networking opportunities in and outside the office.  
• Engaging in our mentorship program  
• Shadowing jobs across the organization to explore your career path potential 
• Participating in Gordon Food Services’ community and stewardship efforts  
• Developing personal and professional skills through workshops about communication, LinkedIn, presenting, and more 
• Embedding directly with a team that treats AI as a core collaborator. You will gain hands-on experience using and developing intelligent systems to deliver real-world business impact 
 Meet the following qualifications to be considered for our 2027 internship program :  
 
• Currently enrolled in a university pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. 
• Must be authorized to work in the US. 
• Must have a 3.0 GPA or higher 
 Taking advantage of our competitive benefits package including:   
 
• Paid Weekly 
• Flex Hours   
• Gordon Food Service Store Discount  
• Employee Assistance Program  
 Ready to start building? Apply today ! 

 BE PART OF AN AMAZING CULTURE WHERE WHAT MATTERS TO YOU, MATTERS TO US!

 Gordon Food Service values our customers and understands that their success is largely dependent upon their workforce. To demonstrate our commitment to our partnership, we will require any candidate who works for a Gordon Food Service customer to provide a letter of support from their management if they are selected for the interview process. 
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity is a matter of policy at Gordon Food Service, Inc. and we are committed to a work environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. 
 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with disability.  If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process due to a disability, please submit your request to talent@gfs.com and use the words “Accommodation Request” in your subject line.
